==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, I am a superhero. I have incredible gymnastic skills, agility, and reflexes. I can even survive falls from incredible heights.
I am not the hero you would call first. I play more of a support role. My job is to figure out a strategy and to help the head heroes execute said strategy.

My greatest achievement was the defeat of a seemingly invincible villain. They could seemingly atomize things with their punches. I helped the heroes realize that the villain's power was actually to teleport anything they touched.
